dz: 美国政治家和外交家约翰·海宣布"开放之门"政策,以促进同中国的贸易.

dz: 爱尔兰民族主义领袖约翰·爱德华·雷德蒙德呼吁反抗英国统治.

dz: 威廉·麦金莱总统将阿拉斯加置于军事统治之下.

de: To combat Czech nationalism, Emperor Franz Joseph decrees German will be language of the Austro-Hungarian Armed Forces.

dz: 贾科莫·普契尼的《托斯卡》在罗马上映。

de: The United States Senate accepts the Anglo-German treaty of 1899 in which the United Kingdom renounces its claims to the Samoan islands.

de: Second Boer War: The Battle of Spion Kop between the forces of the South African Republic and the Orange Free State and British forces ends in a British defeat.

te: Boers stop a British attempt to break the Siege of Ladysmith in the Battle of Spion Kop.
dz: 第二次布尔战争:布尔斯在"斯皮翁克普之战"中阻止了英国人打碎"女铁匠之围"的企图.
de: Second Boer War: Boers stop a British attempt to break the Siege of Ladysmith in the Battle of Spion Kop.

dz: Datu Muhammad Salleh被杀死在坦布南的Kampung Teboh,结束了Mat Salleh叛乱.
de: Datu Muhammad Salleh is killed in Kampung Teboh, Tambunan, ending the Mat Salleh Rebellion.

t: 大不列颠 在关键战役被布尔斯所击败 命名为罗伯茨勋爵 英国驻南非部队指挥官.
te: Great Britain, defeated by Boers in key battles, names Lord Roberts commander of British forces in South Africa.
dz: 大不列颠 在关键战役被布尔斯所击败 命名为罗伯茨勋爵 英国驻南非部队指挥官.
de: Great Britain, defeated by Boers in key battles, names Lord Roberts commander of British forces in South Africa.

dz: 常设仲裁法院是海牙的一个国际仲裁法院,由荷兰参议院批准1899年和平会议法令后设立.
de: The Permanent Court of Arbitration, an international arbitration court at The Hague, is created when the Senate of the Netherlands ratifies an 1899 peace conference decree.

dz: 第二次布尔战争:英国军队第三次试图解除"女铁匠之围"失败.

dz: 戴维斯杯比赛成立.

dz: 英国陆军开始图格拉高地之战,以努力解除"女铁匠之围".
de: The British Army begins the Battle of the Tugela Heights in an effort to lift the Siege of Ladysmith.

t: 由卡斯腾·博克克列文克(Carsten Borchgrevink)所率领的"南方十字"探险队在…
te: The Southern Cross expedition led by Carsten Borchgrevink achieves a new Farthest South of 78° 50'S, making the first l…
dz: 由卡斯腾·博克克列文克(Carsten Borchgrevink)所率领的"南方十字"探险队在西经78°50'实现一个新的"最远南",使"大冰障"号首次登陆.
de: The Southern Cross expedition led by Carsten Borchgrevink achieves a new Farthest South of 78° 50'S, making the first landing at the Great Ice Barrier.

t: 帝国军队在"血腥星期日"上遭受了最惨重的一日生命损失,这是帕德贝格战役的第一天.

de: Second Boer War: Imperial forces suffer their worst single-day loss of life on Bloody Sunday, the first day of the Battle of Paardeberg.

te: During the Battle of the Tugela Heights, the first British attempt to take Hart's Hill fails.
dz: 第二次布尔战争:在图格拉高地战役中,英国第一次试图取取哈特山地的尝试失败.
de: Second Boer War: During the Battle of the Tugela Heights, the first British attempt to take Hart's Hill fails.

dz: 英国工党成立。
de: The British Labour Party is founded.

dz: 第二次布尔战争:在南非,英国军事领导人在保德堡战役中收到布尔将军皮特·克龙杰无条件投降的通知.
de: Second Boer War: In South Africa, British military leaders receive an unconditional notice of surrender from Boer General Piet Cronjé at the Battle of Paardeberg.

dz: 拜仁慕尼黑足球俱乐部成立。

te: The Gold Standard Act is ratified, placing the United States currency on the gold standard.
dz: 《黄金标准法》获得批准,将美国货币置于黄金标准之上.

dz: 纽约市市长罗伯特·安德森·范怀克 (Robert Anderson Van Wyck) 为连接曼哈顿和布鲁克林的新地下“快速交通铁路”破土动工。

t: 克里特克诺索斯的考古学家发现了第一块以象形文字写作的粘土平板,后来被称作"线性B".
te: Archaeologists in Knossos, Crete, discover the first clay tablet with hieroglyphic writing in a script later called Lin…

t: 国会颁布后一天,威廉·麦金莱总统签署"福克法案"成为法律,给予波多黎各有限的自治权.

t: 儿童小说"奥兹的神奇魔法师"由L. Frank Baum出品,最早在美国出版. 初一正本取给作…

de: The luxury racing yacht Idler capsizes and sinks on Lake Erie during a storm, drowning six of its seven passengers (all members of the family of Cleveland businessman James C. Corrigan).

de: The steamer Deutschland of Hamburg America Lines sets a new record for the eastward passage when it docks in Plymouth, England, five days, 11 hours and 45 minutes after sailing from New York, breaking by three hours, six minutes its previous mark in its maiden voyage in July.

dz: 第二次布尔战争期间的埃兰德河战役由英国人解除了长达13天的围攻后结束. 这场战斗开始于2000至3000名布尔斯人的部队包围了由500名澳大利亚人,罗得西亚人,加拿大人和英国士兵组成的部队在Brakfontein Drift的一个补给站.
de: The Battle of Elands River during the Second Boer War ends after a 13-day siege is lifted by the British. The battle had begun when a force of between 2,000 and 3,000 Boers had surrounded a force of 500 Australians, Rhodesians, Canadians and British soldiers at a supply dump at Brakfontein Drift.

de: The French actress Sarah Bernhardt receives the press at the Savoy Hotel in New York at the outset of her first visit since 1896. She talked about her impending tour with a troupe of more than 50 performers and her plans to play the title role in Hamlet.
